findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The Roadmap section still renders `board_graph.dependencies`. In `src/forge/board_graph.py:71-72,123-128`, that renderer removes finished planned stories from their roadmap positions and adds separate “Finished” and “No plan yet” headings. A roadmap with a finished story followed by an unfinished story therefore appears out of roadmap order, contrary to Done-when 12’s no-grouping rule. The new section test checks headings only in Stories, so it does not catch this.

Raise: Gate. The recorded `Functional check:` paragraph reports the bar’s height, the Overview heading offset, and the first-screen height. It gives no observed result for following the four links, folding sections, distinguishing stories by key, or reading cold-read rounds and dispositions. Those are the user actions this part covers, so the required functional check skips covered behavior.
